points.description: States that the statement is FALSE.

Justifies that each process is an independent entity needing its own separate OS state or PCB (tracking its execution, memory, open files or stack), so a single shared PCB with a reference counter cannot work.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.75) if the student says processes are independent or need separate state but does not say a shared PCB is wrong, or gives only a vague reason.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the verdict FALSE and a justification that each process is independent and needs its own separate process state (its own PCB or OS record), so one shared PCB with a reference counter is wrong. Exact technical wording is not needed; any clear statement of separate per-process state counts. Give part marks for a vague but correct direction, and no marks for a TRUE verdict or a justification that accepts the shared PCB idea or is unrelated.
